errors.text: The hypothesis changes the material from a lamellar FCC/B2 Al0.7CoCrFeNi eutectic alloy to a W-Ni-Fe-Ta refractory alloy, so it does not address the target alloy's incoherent-interface cracking problem.
It replaces the defining 6 GPa, 1473 K, 2-hour HPHT intervention with rolling and precipitation aging and therefore cannot reconstruct the pressure-induced hierarchical microstructure.
The proposed experiment does not include an HPHT-versus-temperature-matched low-pressure control or the target fracture-surface and phase-resolved GND measurements.
